purpose: A 24-hour dial, midnight at top, where the accent wedge is the time left in the day. It drains to nothing at midnight and refills in one frame. No hands: a hairline datum at 12 and a heavy boundary at now.

night.recipe: The spent area, ticks and ink flip with the palette; the wedge stays the accent.

options.intent: calendar-day drains to midnight; awake drains to the configured bedtime instead.
hours for reading the time, quarters for a calmer disc, none for a bare gauge.
remaining prints the hours-and-minutes-left line inside the spent area; none for a pure disc.

antiPatterns.rule: Do not animate the midnight refill
antiPatterns.why: it refills in a single frame by design; an animation draws attention to the one moment nobody watches

specless: A wedge and a datum, no hands or ticks in the hand vocabulary.
